The installer writes a zero trace for an unselected environment; therefore any derived original_newton_converged=false value in that row is not a fresh reading of that environment's FGMRES certificate. Interpret primary_policy_eligible as the authoritative selection field; this does not alter solver state or certificate.

nonblocking_observations: Ineligible environments keep their original Newton solution and follow the ordinary Armijo pass. At/after the configured primary index the policy intentionally has no second CGLS fallback pass, including for those environments; the enabled log states armijo_fallback_allowed=false. This is an explicit experimental policy and should remain described as such.
